hypotheses.name: Hypothesis: WETH–USDG–CASHCAT triangle at 0.001 WETH
hypotheses.rationale: The graph has this WETH → USDG → CASHCAT → WETH path through the 10000-fee USDG/WETH, 10000-fee CASHCAT/USDG, and 10000-fee CASHCAT/WETH pools. Hypothesis: a temporary relative-price mismatch across these pools could produce a positive round trip that clears the 1.5× known-gas reserve and 30 bps net-edge rule. This exact route/size cell is unquoted in the supplied cohort and requires fresh quotes; no other size’s output is inferred.

hypotheses.name: Hypothesis: WETH–PONS–CASHCAT triangle at 0.02 WETH
hypotheses.rationale: The graph contains this WETH → PONS → CASHCAT → WETH route through the 3000-, 10000-, and 3000-fee pools. Hypothesis: temporary divergence between the PONS/CASHCAT pool and the two WETH-linked pools may create a round-trip surplus at this exact size; the entry rule requires fresh quotes to establish that any surplus exceeds both the known-gas reserve and 30 bps. The exact route/size cell is not evidenced by a supplied quote, so its output and edge remain unknown.

limitations: The prior-trial memory records rejected tests on other route/size cells; none validates these proposed cells or a forward result.
The cohort contains no exact-size quote for either proposal; both need fresh same-block quotes before any edge assessment.

No live strategy change is proposed. Keep the original control and seven-day/1000-observation acceptance gate; a ten-row screen can reject an unproductive idea but cannot establish acceptance or profit.
analysis.summary: Two unquoted, exact-size paper experiments are proposed on distinct CASHCAT triangle paths. Their rationales are hypotheses, not measured edge claims; the supplied training quotes do not validate either forward result.
